verdict.rationale: The evidence includes content from the product's public GitHub repository (github.com/Flagsmith/flagsmith), and the docs say users can self-host the complete platform. Both imply the source is publicly readable, but no item names a license or explicitly calls the code open source. missing for 10: explicit statement of an open-source license (e.g., license name/terms), confirmation that the full server/dashboard source is in the public repo, independent corroboration of license openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Self-hosting Flagsmith allows you to run the complete Flagsmith platform within your own infrastructure
You can use Docker to set up an entire Flagsmith Feature Flag environment locally
